messages:
hana: CI artifact oversize on PR 4820 — new sparse-attn kernels pushed a huge fatbin.
darren: which file hit the limit?
hana: libserve_runtime.so in the linux-x86_64 artifact. size went from 44MB -> 92MB after kernel additions.
olive: likely we compiled too many arch variants + both ptx+cubin.
rick: can you paste the nvcc command from CI?
hana: sure:
```
nvcc -O3 -Xcompiler "-fPIC" -gencode arch=compute_75,code=sm_75 -gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -ptx -cubin -lineinfo -Xfatbin --compress-all -o kernels.fatbin kernels.cu
```
julia: -lineinfo and both -ptx and -cubin will bloat things. also ptx+cubin for each arch duplicates kernels.
infra-bot: buildkite #6123 failed: artifact size limit 100MB exceeded (artifact=redwood-linux-staging.tgz size=112MB)
olive: proposals:
• only build native cubin for CI release artifact
• keep a single PTX target for fallback (compute_80)
• create a separate 'all-arch' debug artifact for nightly/label builds
• strip debug sections and run objcopy --compress-debug-sections in final stage
rick: agree. also prefer `-gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80` and `-gencode=arch=compute_80,code=compute_80` to emit one cubin + one ptx for the same compute.
julia: careful: removing PTX for some combos broke JIT on older drivers earlier. need to guarantee at least one PTX that ptxas can compile on target.
hana: experiments locally: switching to release nvcc flags and adding `objcopy --strip-unneeded` in final docker shrank lib by ~30MB.
darren: alternative: split fatbins per-arch and upload separate artifacts per arch. runtime can choose correct bundle at startup.
olive: splitting increases S3 objects and complexity. prefer default single release with limited arch list + gated all-arch artifact.
ci-bot: suggestion: add a size-delta check in CI that comments on PR and warns if artifact grows >5MB or >10%.
julia: also add `nvcc -v` to CI logs to track ptxas changes across toolchain updates.
rick: we should update the kernel onboarding doc (RFC follow-up) to require a size measurement and a local `nvcc` invocation template.
hana: decision: for PR/CI artifacts -> build only native cubin (sm_86) + compute_80 PTX fallback; enable full arch build as a separate nightly/debug job. Add strip+compress in final stage.
olive: action items:
- update CI matrix to default single-arch (PR: @olive)
- add nightly 'fatbin-all-archs' pipeline (PR: @darren)
- add objcopy strip + compress step in dockerfile (PR: @julia)
- implement size-delta comment plugin (PR: @rick)
- update kernel onboarding doc with nvcc flags + checklist (PR: @hana)
ci-bot: created ticket INFRA-983 for size-delta plugin.
hana: re-run PR build with release flags, passes size gate now. thanks!
olive: follow-up: we'll add a short section to the serving runtime RFC describing recommended nvcc invocations and CI artifact policies.
rick: also keep an eye on ptxas versions; small ptx changes can swing size a lot.
julia: noted, I will add nvcc version to the build metadata.
infra-bot: artifact uploaded redwood-runtime-1819876543-release.tgz (size 68MB)
